Step ①: At the title screen with cleared save data.
Step ②: Enter the secret code [spoiler]Left, Right, Left, Right, Up, Up, Down, Down, A[/spoiler].
Step ③: Check the message window and select “Yes.”

[h3]【Unlock Method B】Clear the main game again[/h3]
Step ①: After the ending, return to the title screen.
Step ②: Select “Continue.”

notes.title: CONERU -Development Note- #14
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the demo!
We hope you're enjoying your 2D action-date adventure with Coneru!

⚡
We’re excited to announce an update to the demo (now Demo_ver1.01), which includes the following fixes and adjustments:

General Changes

Increased the attack power of all weapons and the Conerun Beam.
Reduced the stat boost provided by the upgraded lightning rods.
Removed the "Capsule Bomb" from the Conerun Beam (it’s currently being adjusted).
DEMO PLAY

Added more healing items in Stage 1.
Increased the number of upgraded lightning rods in Stage 1.
Fixed a bug where players could get stuck in the concrete blocks in Stage 1.
Increased the HP of the "Site Foreman" boss.
TIME ATTACK

Increased the number of upgraded lightning rods in Stage 1.
Updated the Site Foreman’s text to display "180 seconds" for the time limit.
Fixed a bug where players could get stuck in the concrete blocks in Stage 1.
We will continue to fine-tune the parameters and healing mechanics based on your feedback. Please feel free to share your thoughts on our community hub, as we’ll use them as a reference for future adjustments.
⚡

We’re committed to improving the game and making your 2D action-date experience with Coneru even more fun, exciting, and smooth! Thank you for your continued support of CONERU -DIMENSION GIRL-.


Also, Great.👍Comment📝Add to Wish List⚡
please remember me😆

Sincerely,
The Development Team

notes.title: CONERU -Development Note- #1
notes.content:
[h1][b]CONERU[/b][/h1]
She is the main character of this work and the core of the story.
She is a naive and fast-paced character. Her trademark is her inazuma-shaped eyes and large spiral twin-tail hair. Her hair ornament in the shape of Saturn, which she made herself as a hobby, is said to be the same size as the real Saturn (in other words, she may be terribly huge...).

[img]https://uc50cfec156d62d41a6aa646b544.previews.dropboxusercontent.com/p/thumb/ACL-3lx5nkuSEE9FLNm9pKDp44E2rHsgONgrpPAFZnARnOGdb67xONmw4NN8oYUufNBtqUSOH2PWlLDnK4LRDgOvSTr3C8jjk6bj6IxCyrnMghRPV5Bw-MANRvuNWiCF3ofyYmloZmsmD0tb63PqQu13rq-L4aMHp9FCfNUszknvUvjjUwalVu5sbUCoTNfp5vprWQm5_GAk4mCBZM6ewHPa7hlie0NHwo2_leFAFTTJ9rY6d0oRgzVb0tzqAknbcojG9VqYXoVa8QHLPC2S-1A50OHsh2avnKxv0xLQx4Mn5AJKrN3fiDypN8z2HRl6YhX8z94xhi_ScDJ3tveIbATQnZAOpQW0wwN2YeKYe3w0V4rj_6pk7XZQwd911EYBwveXSC_K_qeBPluO6qTNUKEQ/p.gif[/img]

[b]Hobbies include dimensional travel[/b]
Her hobby is dimensional travel, in which she incarnates herself as a soul into a life form or substance somewhere in the universe, thereby moving through all of space and time. She can cause such subspace travel on her own, but she is inexperienced in controlling it...so she often uses the services of a dimensional travel company.

[b]Unexpected trouble[/b]
For this trip, she had arranged for a "fluffy plan" to be born on earth as the soul of a cat, but due to a mistake by the dimensional travel agency, she ended up incarnating an artificial life form that would normally not be able to harbor a soul. (This eccentric appearance could be called a "soul incarnation bug.)

[img]https://uc6277f787dd027d31551bcb1b4f.previews.dropboxusercontent.com/p/thumb/ACIZof_0em9QdvB_HN9dh0gIS7CnSl4MEINiPehoOTP3hiExP1KOlzsUhUQXtqMdnpGASKHh4r_x19wb0HCTbV3PIus4rJ3kCDsoXAIBi6b1wqHLKUVr6FE8qgg__kIBNp0g5eLWt_5DHpXcL9Pg3tLAFEOa3UdNr4--HcXJ2pcnHTgykSPVlzLHQfP_1j5lOgUN3ojM6k8FNlbTJfI-ZhaVBR1yfps0izn0IGAgD2lM2XFhuxyNTtcuErzKhopSy8pvRVtlY1oJIHy-8T5Aa-IcAdR6s3XX1w5Zw14wyOPJLDJTu8uyWHrePxL1JhXQBCvC4DU6_BIRQkA4edaqiwAKQ3DX-AKt0gTmYkZYWjCkWWpMqlvIYNTYpTIPiPo9F3B3IvfcKYhg5J3Tw0lUyr3X9cJr3_RMpyqccdpZ8AOzvA/p.gif[/img]

[b]And so it begins, a two-dimensional co-located life![/b]
This is exactly what happens when you meet (merge? live together?) with Socrates, the other protagonist of this work, i.e. you. Living together?) and the beginning of 2D action dating!
